paper_000.title: DeepPoseKit - animal pose estimation using deep learning
key_facts: Stacked DenseNet architecture for pose estimation
paper_000.relevance_to_task: Provides context for pose estimation upstream of SimBA feature engineering

paper_001.title: MARS - Mouse Action Recognition System
key_facts: Supervised classifiers for attack, mounting, close investigation
Random forest on pose-derived features achieves human-level performance
9 keypoints per mouse in top view
paper_001.relevance_to_task: Directly comparable pipeline; MARS uses RF on pose features for social behavior classification, same approach as SimBA

paper_002.title: DeepEthogram - supervised behavior classification from raw pixels
key_facts: Classifies behaviors directly from raw video pixels
Uses Hidden Two-Stream Networks and temporal context
paper_002.relevance_to_task: Alternative paradigm (pixel-based vs pose-feature-based); highlights SimBA's transparency advantage

paper_003.title: B-SOiD - unsupervised algorithm for behavior identification
paper_003.relevance_to_task: Contrasts with SimBA's supervised approach; B-SOiD discovers behaviors rather than classifying predefined ones

paper_004.title: SLEAP - multi-animal pose tracking
paper_004.relevance_to_task: Upstream pose estimation tool compatible with SimBA workflow

baselines_from_related_work: MARS RF classifier as direct comparison baseline
